comments: 70f4c8d9: ;Routine Description: Handles the checking and updating of discharge summaries and their statuses within the VistA system.

d9a54d1b: ;Function CHECK: Validates and updates the discharge summary status for a given patient (DFN) on a specific date (DGJTDT) with parameters (DGJPARM), potentially creating a new record if necessary.
e80b5266: ;Initialize local variable to check if operation should exit.
aee77029: ;Retrieve parameters for the division associated with the discharge summary.
7d4752d2: ;Exit if division parameters are not set.
e0cd6ac8: ;Set the default discharge summary type if not already specified.
33897e25: ;If an IRT record exists and has no discharge date, flag it for update and quit.
5446a70f: ;Exit if an IRT record already exists for the discharge summary.
7b552386: ;Loop through discharge summaries for the patient to find a match.
993c1182: ;If a matching discharge summary is found, set flag to stop the loop.
79eea9f6: ;If no existing record is found, call ADD to create a new entry.
4fd1a771: ;Exit point for the CHECK function.
f53d4995: ;Subroutine ADD: Creates a new discharge summary record for a patient.
9d79c912: ;Define variables to be used for the new summary entry.
cb8b184a: ;Set the service related to the ward if available.
48147690: ;Determine the service section for the discharge summary.
cd564392: ;Retrieve the service period related to the discharge.
93254169: ;Set document type for the discharge summary.
dd8aac1d: ;Set additional document type if applicable based on parameters.
35b53276: ;Set event date and ward for the summary.
56cb13c3: ;File the new discharge summary entry.
87a7e99c: ;Exit if the new record could not be created.
f941e208: ;Lock the new record for editing.
561b49a0: ;Update the fields for the new discharge summary record.
872c1bc2: ;Execute the update for the discharge summary.
2dcf4627: ;Unlock the record after updating.
ea0f9b67: ;Set flag to indicate a new record has been added.
471fca2e: ;Function EDIT: Updates specific fields of a discharge summary record.
8f6c290b: ;Lock the record for editing.
4509d56f: ;Set the fields to be updated for the discharge summary.
98e6fbb5: ;Execute the update and call STAT1 to update the status.
f6de194c: ;Unlock the record after updating.
665ab386: ;Exit point for the EDIT function.
36aaa27d: ;Subroutine DCSDEL: Deletes specific fields from a discharge summary record.
a75cd078: ;Lock the record for deletion.
ebc89854: ;Clear the specified fields from the discharge summary.
0f8d0bb3: ;Execute the deletion and call STAT1 to update the status.
947cf24a: ;Unlock the record after deletion.
5b79313f: ;Exit point for the DCSDEL subroutine.
d226777b: ;Function SIGUP: Updates the signature block of a discharge summary.
d5e9397a: ;Lock the record for signature update.
e214345a: ;Set the signature block fields for the discharge summary.
b69017fc: ;Execute the signature update and call STAT1 to update the status.
334566d6: ;Unlock the record after signature update.
3733bbe6: ;Exit point for the SIGUP function.
3f8e1d4f: ;Subroutine STAT1: Determines and updates the status of a discharge summary based on its fields.
2f3784a3: ;Define local variables for status update.
7450ebc8: ;Retrieve the DT node for the discharge summary.
1d2a3221: ;Set status to INCOMPLETE if no completion date.
d443207a: ;Set status to DICTATED if no dictation date.
75942ac9: ;Set status to TRANSCRIBED if no transcription date.
dac04369: ;Set status to SIGNED NO REVIEW if parameter is set and no review date.
ff7f009a: ;Set status to SIGNED if signed but not reviewed.
08ce7333: ;Set status to REVIEWED if review date is present.
8d04382e: ;Update the discharge summary record with the new status.
59b8510d: ;Exit point for the STAT1 subroutine.
a23c4e9a: ;Subroutine DOC: Determines the document type for the discharge summary.
78260e0d: ;Retrieve the parameter for the document type.
cf98c30b: ;Set the document type based on service period.
f38c122e: ;Exit point for the DOC subroutine.
